Work closely with clients and internal project teams throughout the implementation lifecycle. Identify implementation risks, data gaps and dependencies and ensure these are addressed ahead of go-live. Support User Acceptance Testing and payroll reconciliation prior to production. Payroll Operations Manage the end-to-end monthly payroll cycle across multiple African countries. Process and review payroll inputs including salaries, allowances, bonuses, deductions, overtime, leave and other payroll components. Perform detailed payroll validation and reconciliation before payroll approval. Ensure payrolls are delivered accurately and in accordance with agreed payroll calendars. Review payroll outputs including payroll reports, payslips, statutory deductions and payment information. Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies and calculation queries. Maintain accurate payroll records and supporting documentation. Support payroll year-end and statutory reporting requirements where applicable. Maintain a strong understanding of payroll legislation and statutory requirements across relevant African jurisdictions. Systems & Data Operate payroll, HRIS and global payroll technology platforms. Manage payroll data uploads, downloads and system interfaces. Review and manipulate payroll data using Excel and other data tools. Support payroll system configuration, testing and process improvements. Identify opportunities to automate payroll processes and improve efficiency. Maintain strong data quality and information security standards. Support the continued development and use of Leap29's global payroll technology. Client Service Act as a senior payroll contact for assigned clients and payrolls. Participate in payroll implementation and operational client meetings. Clearly explain payroll calculations, processes and country-specific requirements. Manage payroll queries through to resolution. Proactively identify risks or issues that could impact payroll delivery. Build strong working relationships with client HR, payroll and finance teams. Ensure payroll services consistently meet Leap29's standards for accuracy, responsiveness and service. Experience & Skills Essential Minimum 3 years' professional payroll experience . Ability to manage multiple payroll calendars, priorities and deadlines simultaneously. Excellent written and spoken English. Comfortable working remotely within an international team. Desirable Experience managing payroll across several regions of Africa, including Southern, East, West and Central Africa. Experience with multinational or global payroll environments. You will be comfortable moving between implementation projects and live payroll operations and will have the technical knowledge and confidence to work across different African payroll environments. Analytical – able to interrogate payroll data and identify discrepancies. Technology focused – comfortable learning and using new payroll and HRIS platforms. Client focused – able to communicate complex payroll matters clearly and professionally. Adaptable – comfortable operating across different countries, legislation and payroll requirements. Proactive – able to identify risks and resolve issues before they affect payroll delivery. Why Join Leap29? This role provides the opportunity to work within a growing international payroll business and play an important part in expanding Leap29's payroll capability across Africa. This organisation is widely recognised by industry analysts and is experiencing rapid global expansion with up to three new Senior AE roles, supported by significant investment and strategic partnerships They sell scalable storage architecture for Financial Services & Large Enterprise Why Consider This Role Gartner Leader Global award winner in Secure Data Storage & a well-known vendor Market-leading technology with strong differentiation Significant growth trajectory and investment - huge global backing Large enterprise deals being closed now in the UK (£500k–£5M) Strong internal support (marketing, pre-sales, channel) Opportunity to build and own strategic accounts and lead the UK team The Role As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will drive new business across Financial Services and other large enterprises in London & UK You will engage at C-level, targeting major banks & financial institutions for one role but also large enterprise for other roles, developing long-term, high-value relationships you can bring & develop Key Responsibilities Identify and win new business opportunities Manage complex enterprise sales cycles Build pipeline within strategic accounts Deliver high-value, outcome-led solutions Ideal Candidate Strong track record in enterprise Experience selling into Financial Services &/or large enterprise ac Comfortable with £500k+ deal Background in storage, infrastructure, cloud, data or cyber sales Proactive, driven, and commercially astute Proven and demonstrable C level contacts you can influence Package Base salary up to £160k with uncapped ote (people in the business in sales earning 7-figs here) Uncapped commission Excellent long-term career prospects - lead the UK expansion & team

review_candidates.title: Salesperson
review_candidates.description: About WIN SOURCE WIN SOURCE – Where Supply Begins Founded in 1999, WIN SOURCE helps manufacturers secure critical electronic components and build more resilient supply chains in an increasingly complex global market,supported by a global team of 450+ employees. Through NEXUS™, our intelligent supply chain platform, and our worldwide network of sourcing, inventory and logistics capabilities, we help customers make smarter sourcing decisions, strengthen supply continuity and respond confidently to evolving market challenges. Today, WIN SOURCE serves customers worldwide through strategically located operations across Asia, Europe and North America, certified facilities and a strong commitment to quality, reliability and operational excellence. About the Role The International Sales Representative role at WIN SOURCE is designed for sales professionals who want to build a long-term career in global B2B business development and electronic component supply chain solutions. In this role, you will focus on customer development, RFQ and quotation support, opportunity follow-up and customer communication, while helping customers address component availability, lead-time pressure, lifecycle transitions and other supply chain challenges. This position goes beyond selling products; it helps you learn how to understand customer procurement and supply chain needs, and create value through WIN SOURCE’s global sourcing and supply capabilities. Working closely with WIN SOURCE’s sales, sourcing, logistics and quality teams, you will gradually build practical experience in international customer development, electronic component markets and supply continuity solutions. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain relationships with new and existing customers across assigned markets. Identify potential business opportunities through market research, customer development, industry platforms and consistent follow-up. Support the complete sales process, including customer communication, RFQ handling, quotation preparation, order follow-up and delivery coordination. Collaborate with internal sourcing, logistics and quality teams to help customers address shortages, lifecycle transitions, EOL risks, lead-time pressure and cost challenges. Maintain accurate customer information, opportunity updates, quotation records and CRM data to support long-term customer development. Continuously build product knowledge, market awareness and customer communication skills to strengthen sales capability in the electronic components industry. Support customer meetings, marketing activities and international exhibitions as needed. Why Join WIN SOURCE At WIN SOURCE, your work creates value beyond individual transactions. You will have the opportunity to: Build or accelerate your international sales career at the center of the global electronic component supply chain. Learn how manufacturing companies approach procurement and sourcing decisions, and how real supply chain challenges are solved beyond transactional sales. Gain exposure to advanced electronics markets such as industrial, automotive, medical, AI infrastructure and other fast-growing sectors. Leverage WIN SOURCE’s global sourcing network, market expertise and cross-functional team support to deliver solutions beyond traditional distribution. Follow a clear career path from sales execution into account management, regional market development and broader commercial management roles. What We Are Looking For 1-2 years of experience in B2B sales, account management, business development or related commercial roles, with a proven ability to develop customers and drive business growth. Experience in electronic components, semiconductors, electronics distribution, EMS or manufacturing supply chains is highly preferred. Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and deliver value-driven solutions. Customer-focused mindset with strong commercial awareness and the ability to manage opportunities throughout the sales cycle. Passion for international sales and business development, with a proactive mindset, strong ownership and the drive to create long-term value in a global environment. Benefits & Career Growth At WIN SOURCE, we support people who are willing to learn, grow and create value in international business. We offer: Competitive base salary with performance-based incentives, giving motivated sales professionals the opportunity to grow their earning potential. Systematic sales training, product knowledge development and hands-on exposure to global electronics markets. Opportunities to collaborate with international customers, strategic accounts and experienced internal teams. The opportunity to help solve real customer challenges related to component supply, supply continuity and business growth. Opportunities to participate in international exhibitions, customer meetings and global business activities as needed. A multicultural and collaborative work environment with teams across Asia, Europe and North America. Career development path: Sales Representative → Sales Specialist / Sales Supervisor → Sales Manager → Regional Sales Manager → Global Sales Management Join WIN SOURCE Ready to grow your international sales career and make an impact in the global electronics supply chain? Apply today and join WIN SOURCE – Where Supply Begins. Submit your application through LinkedIn or send your resume to: careers@win-source.net Follow WIN SOURCE on LinkedIn for the latest company updates, industry insights and career opportunities.
